messages:
Ava M: Quick kickoff — CloudVendor integration launch + partner roadshow. Goal: coordinated marketplace listing, benchmark blog, and a 45-min joint webinar. Proposed target week: May 9-15. :rocket:
Priya G: Love it. Can we tie the benchmark to the demo flows customers care about (chat latency + cost per 1k tokens)?
Marco S: Routing note — all webinar signups need to map to SFDC campaign 'CloudVendor-Launch-2026' and drop into Partner_SDR queue. I'll supply the webform payload mapping. :white_check_mark:
Sam L: For the webinar we should have 3 segments: (1) why integration matters, (2) live demo (10 min), (3) benchmark walk + Q&A. Who's demo lead?
Jon K: I can demo the integration; will prep a short runbook for reliability questions. Need access to staging CloudVendor account by next Tue.
Nadia P: I'll draft the launch blog and benchmark narrative. Outline: TL;DR, customer problem, joint solution, 1-2 charts (latency vs cost), call-to-action to register. Want the raw numbers by EOD Fri.
Ava M: Great. Dependencies: staging access (Sam/Jon), benchmark script + datasets (Priya/Sam), marketing assets (Nadia). Marco to confirm SFDC fields + UTM scheme.
Marco S: UTM pattern suggestion: `?utm_source=partner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=cloudvendor_launch&utm_content={asset}`. Also please include `partner=cloudvendor` hidden field so we can auto-assign. Example payload snippet:
```
{ "email": "...", "utm_campaign": "cloudvendor_launch", "partner": "cloudvendor" }
```
Priya G: For the benchmark, I'm thinking two workloads: interactive chat (avg 40 tokens/turn) and batch embedding run (10k docs). We'll report p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and model fallback behavior.
Sam L: Can we record the demo under 10 min? Short and repeatable. Also capture terminal + UI so we can reuse clips for social.
Nadia P: I'll build hero graphic and 1-page benchmark PDF. Who owns the gated asset? If gated, we need an MQL flow defined.
Marco S: Gated asset => MQL. Routing-bot will tag lead source and create lead with `Lead_Source__c = "CloudVendor Webinar"`. I'll set up a trigger to assign to Partner_SDR.
routing-bot: automation: created SFDC campaign 'CloudVendor-Launch-2026' and prepped form mapping. Please test form submission to confirm assignment.
Ava M: Timeline check: this week - benchmark runs + staging access. Next week - finalize blog + landing page + SFDC wiring. Week after - webinar dry runs and publish. Is that feasible?
Jon K: Staging request submitted (ticket #1234). Should be approved by tomorrow.
Priya G: I'll run the first benchmark pass by Fri 18:00 PT and upload CSV to the shared drive: https://redwood.app/s/CloudVendor-bench.
Nadia P: Draft outline ready. I'll ping for review when numbers are in. Need a 1-line quote from Jon and a customer quote if possible.
Marco S: Also confirm GDPR-consent checkbox on form; partner legal asked for explicit opt-in.
Ava M: Action owners summary: Jon (demo + staging), Priya (benchmarks), Nadia (blog + assets), Marco (lead routing + UTM), Sam (slides + recording plan). I'll schedule weekly 30-min syncs M/W next week.
Sam L: For the webinar slide deck, I'll include an ops appendix with failover behavior + rollout plan — good for product folks asking SLO questions.
Jon K: Will provide a 2-3 sentence partner quote and a short list of customer references (non-sensitive).
Nadia P: Draft publish checklist: blog, landing page, benchmark PDF, slide deck, recording link, utm/form test, SFDC campaign active, email copy, social blurbs. I'll convert to Asana and tag everyone.
Priya G: One more ask — let's include a small AB test on the landing page CTA: 'Get the benchmark' vs 'See a live demo' to gauge intent. Marco, can routing map CTAs to separate lead queues?
Marco S: Yes — map `cta=benchmark` to Content_Nurture, `cta=demo` to Partner_SDR. We'll capture `cta` param on submission.
Ava M: Perfect. Last piece: what do we want the webinar CTA to be? Nadia, recommend primary CTA -> 'Request trial + integration walkthrough' and secondary -> 'Download benchmark'.
Nadia P: Agreed. I'll craft copy accordingly.
Ava M: Okay team — next steps: run bench (Priya), confirm SFDC mapping (Marco), staging + demo runbook (Jon), first draft blog and slides (Nadia/Sam). Sync tomorrow 11am PT. :calendar:
Jon K: Noted. See you tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Ava M: Thanks all. I'll post the Asana board when it's created. :rocket:
